content: If you miss a dose of this medication, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Avoid storing it in the bathroom. Do not dispose of this medication by flushing it down the toilet or pouring it into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard the medication when it is expired or no longer needed, following local disposal guidelines. This information was last updated in August 2024. It is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific situation. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete details about this medication and your individual health needs. In the event of an overdose, if the person has severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away.
